blocks.title: Privacy Policy
blocks.subtitle: Data & Cookies
blocks.text:
Last updated: 24 November 2026

This privacy policy explains which personal data Webdevamin processes, why, on which legal basis, who receives it, how long it is kept and which rights you have. It applies to visitors of webdevamin.com, to people who contact us or request a quote, and to our clients.

1. Who is responsible

The controller is Webdevamin, a sole proprietorship (eenmanszaak) registered in Belgium with company and VAT number BE0798993057, located at Eigen-Haardstraat 39, 8400 Ostend, Belgium. You can reach us at amin@webdevamin.com for every question about your data.

When we build or host a website or booking system for a client, we process the data of that client's visitors and customers on the client's behalf. In that case the client is the controller and we are the processor. Those rules are in our processing agreement.

2. What we process, why and on which legal basis

Contact form, quote requests and calls

When you contact us or request a quote, we receive your name, email address and message, and, if you fill them in, your phone number, company name, current website and answers about your project (such as what you need, your sector, features, timing and budget), plus the page you sent the request from. We use this to answer you and to prepare a quote.

Legal basis: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in answering questions about our services (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

AI assistant (chat)

The chat on this website is an AI assistant, not a person. Your questions and the answers are processed by our own platform (webdevamin.app), which has the answers written by OpenAI based on the content of this website. Please do not share sensitive details in the chat. Your IP address is only used briefly to limit too many questions in a row and is not stored with the conversation. The ongoing conversation is also kept in your browser tab until you close it.

Legal basis: our legitimate interest in answering visitors quickly (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Clients: contracts, invoices and payments

When you become a client, we process your name or company name, contact person, email address, phone number, billing address, VAT number (for businesses), Peppol ID (if you have one), your price and billing period, your invoices and your payment status. For SEPA direct debit you enter your IBAN and sign the mandate on a secure page of our payment provider Stripe. We do not see or store your full bank details ourselves. We also give you an account in our client platform (webdevamin.app) to manage your website or booking system.

Legal basis: performance of the contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legal obligations under Belgian tax and accounting law (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).

Statistics and advertising (only with your consent)

If you click Accept in the cookie banner, we use PostHog to see how the website is used (page views, clicks, errors and session recordings in which form fields and the chat are masked) and Google Ads to measure and improve our advertisements. If you click Decline, these tools are not loaded.

Legal basis: your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and Article 129 of the Belgian Electronic Communications Act). You can withdraw it at any time through Cookie settings at the bottom of every page.

Reviews, maps and videos

On the Dutch pages we show a review widget from Trustlocal, but only after you accepted cookies. Google Maps and YouTube videos only load after you accepted cookies or clicked the load button. At that moment Google receives your IP address and may set cookies.

Legal basis: your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).

Hosting, security and spam protection

The website runs on Cloudflare, which processes technical data such as your IP address and browser details to deliver the pages and protect them against attacks. When you use a form, Cloudflare Turnstile checks that you are not a bot.

Legal basis: our legitimate interest in a safe and working website (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

3. Who receives your data

We do not sell your data. We only share it with service providers that need it to do their job for us, under a data processing agreement:

  • Cloudflare (hosting, security, Turnstile). Cloudflare, Inc., United States. Transfers are covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses.
  • Supabase (database of our client platform). Data stored in Ireland (EU).
  • Amazon Web Services (sending emails and text messages). Region Ireland (EU).
  • OpenAI (answers of the AI assistant). United States. Covered by Standard Contractual Clauses. Data sent through the API is not used to train its models.
  • PostHog (statistics, only with consent). Data stored in the EU (Frankfurt).
  • Google (Google Ads with consent, Google Maps and YouTube after a click). Google Ireland Limited, with possible transfers to the United States under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
  • Stripe (payments and SEPA direct debit for clients). Stripe Payments Europe, Limited, Ireland, with possible transfers to the United States under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses.
  • Accountable (our bookkeeping). Belgium. Receives a copy of every client invoice.
  • peppol.sh (delivery of e-invoices over the Peppol network, only for business clients with a Peppol ID).
  • Trustlocal (review widget, only with consent). Belgium.

We also share data when the law requires it, for example with the tax authorities.

4. How long we keep your data

  • Enquiries and quote requests: up to 2 years after our last contact, unless they lead to a contract.
  • Chat conversations: 90 days.
  • Client data, contracts and invoices: for the duration of the contract and afterwards for 10 years, as Belgian accounting and tax law requires.
  • Session recordings (PostHog): 90 days. Other statistics: as long as our PostHog plan keeps them, at most 7 years.
  • Your cookie choice: 1 year.

5. Cookies and similar technologies

  • wda-consent (necessary): remembers your cookie choice. 1 year.
  • webdevamin-chat (necessary, browser tab storage): keeps the ongoing chat until you close the tab.
  • Cloudflare and Turnstile (necessary): security and spam protection. Short-lived.
  • ph_* (PostHog) (statistics, consent only): recognises your browser between visits. Up to 1 year.
  • _gcl_* and other Google Ads cookies (advertising, consent only): measure which ads lead to contact. Up to 90 days.
  • Trustlocal (consent only): shows our reviews.
  • Google Maps and YouTube (only after a click or consent): may set Google cookies.

You can change your choice at any time through Cookie settings at the bottom of every page. If you withdraw consent, we remove the statistics and advertising cookies we can reach and stop loading those tools.

6. Your rights

You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict or object to its processing, to data portability and to withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting processing that already took place. Send your request to amin@webdevamin.com. We answer within one month.

If you think we do not handle your data correctly, you can file a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit), Drukpersstraat 35, 1000 Brussels, contact@apd-gba.be, www.dataprotectionauthority.be.

7. Other information

  • We do not use your data for automated decisions or profiling with legal or similar effects.
  • Our website and services are not aimed at children under 16.
  • We protect your data with encrypted connections (HTTPS), access only for people who need it and reliable service providers.

8. Changes

We update this policy when our services or the law change. The date at the top shows the latest version. For important changes we inform our clients by email.

9. Contact

Webdevamin, Eigen-Haardstraat 39, 8400 Ostend, Belgium, VAT BE0798993057, amin@webdevamin.com.
